race.comment: KISSATTACK (13) and SENTALOA (9) both come through a race over this track and distance where they started near-equal favourites. KISSATTACK beat SENTALOA home fairly comfortably there and was only half a length off the winner. She does draw wide but looks a key hope off that. SENTALOA did beat KISSATTACK home at Yarra Valley prior but not by as much. SOARING LEGEND (10) is the different form and a horse with upside. He's only had three runs to date but looks as if he'll relish the extra ground. ASHINA (11) was poor at Donald last time but her form prior reads well, she can bounce back. FANTASTIC BEAST (3) is going well and an each way hope.
